name: caremesh
description: Enterprise healthcare interoperability and care coordination platform

scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @caremesh/api && npm run build --workspace @caremesh/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @caremesh/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @caremesh/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @caremesh/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @caremesh/api && npm run lint --workspace @caremesh/web
